name: Bulwark
summary: At Tirisfal's edge, Bulwark keeps watch over the Western Plaguelands. Forsaken and Argent Dawn forces hold the outpost together, and Horde expeditions set out from there into the tainted east.

sections.title: A Shield Against the Scourge
sections.body: Forsaken guards hold Bulwark's palisade where Tirisfal Glades meets the Western Plaguelands. The outpost bars the road from blighted lands where the undead roam. Here, Forsaken forces work with the neutral Argent Dawn. Together, they call on seasoned Horde champions to strike at the Scourge and keep the Lich King's minions from reaching Tirisfal.

faq.q: What is the purpose of the Bulwark?
faq.answer: Bulwark is the Horde's forward defense against the Scourge and a base for its forces. It guards Tirisfal Glades and the Undercity from attacks out of the Western Plaguelands. Argent Dawn and Forsaken commanders coordinate strikes into the blighted lands.

faq.q: Can Alliance characters visit the Bulwark to speak with the Argent Dawn?
faq.answer: No. The Argent Dawn representatives at Bulwark are neutral, but Forsaken guards garrison the encampment. Alliance visitors who enter the palisade are attacked on sight.

faq.q: Is the Bulwark safe for young adventurers leaving Tirisfal?
aliases: can low levels go past bulwark
faq.answer: No. The gate opens onto Tirisfal Glades, but the Western Plaguelands beyond hold deadly undead and plague cauldrons. Novice travelers who pass the palisade face swift death.

angles.text: As Forsaken, you stand watch at Bulwark's narrow passage against the Lich King's armies. They must not march straight on Brill and the Undercity.
As Horde, you have Bulwark as your main gate and base for operations across the Plaguelands. The Alliance holds Chillwind Camp opposite.
